rules: All object properties exact. Numbers finite; integers safe. Boolean is not integer.
Only status without session_id may return null session. Other session.id and runtime bind exact request.
Active reason null. Stopped reason non-null. Stop idempotent; same stopped session start never renews TTL.
Identical active start idempotent after defaults. Different active session/options busy. New session replaces one retained stopped report.
first_seq<=next_seq; empty ring first_seq=next_seq. event_count is retained count. dropped_events=rate_dropped+ring_dropped+oversized_dropped.
Allocate sequence for every candidate including drops. Start/terminal bypass rate filtering. Reserve terminal slot and2048bytes while active.
Read sorted unique events after after_seq, bounded by count and61440serialized UTF8 data bytes. Reject after_seq>=next_seq. lost_before=max(0,first_seq-after_seq-1).
next_after_seq equals last returned sequence while more=true; otherwise next_seq-1 including trailing drops. Export freezes highwater=next_seq-1; never tails forever.

at_ms nondecreasing elapsed. Use fixed expiry timer independent of wall rollback. Wall fallback labelled; do not derive durations across regressed wallclock. HLS offsets may predate session; only map observed same-realm performance times. Never derive loader timings from event receipt.
Ranges ordered by index, start<=end. Return<=8 adjacent ranges around playhead including containing one; truncated=total-returned. Unavailable count/truncated null and[]; genuine empty0/0/[].
Unsupported frame source requires null counters. Preserve measured zero. dropped<=total when both measured. Counter or owner resets invalidate deltas.
Local labels only, never hashes/copies of URLs/tokens/event/entity/camera IDs. Bound correlation storage independently.

Only observed supported notification stages/timings emitted. Opaque queue/coalescing and isolated image decode unsupported: queue_ms/decode_ms null and supports absent. image_load_decode_ms is combined src-to-onload.
OFF adds no perf instrumentation/network work. Gate only diagnostic1Hz loop to explicit lease; snapshots omit unavailable loop metrics. Retain eventhistory and mandatory recovery.
Ordinary media/HLS/source replacement continues with new source label, owner rebinding and source_changed mark. Stop on TTL/request/runtime/config/disconnect/pagehide; no autorestart.
Stop removes all instrumentation and rejects late callbacks. Retain bounded report300s; discard on credential/runtime retirement.

Notifications experiment uses typed notificationsEnabled integer0/1 default1; receiver revision/raw/runtime/context CAS, including legacy/UI same-value setters. Restore only own receipt. Missingdefault1 restored as stored1 is policy restoration, not byte restoration.
Supported flags describe detected platform capability independently of requested flags; never instantiate observers to probe support. Loop optional metrics are null unless requested and supported.

Supported notification stage/timing arrays contain no duplicates. Event at_ms <= session elapsed_ms; event seq < session next_seq. Stopped remaining_ms is zero; active remaining_ms <= duration_seconds*1000.
Read more=true requires at least one event and a strictly advancing next_after_seq. A repeated stopped-session start must match normalized duration/options or return busy; it never renews the lease.

playback_rate is an observed nullable number0..16. HLS fragment_buffered uses completed FRAG_BUFFERED stats. HLS detail is a fixed projected code, never raw errors. Media reason is null until an owner-supported reason exists.

hls_buffer records actual public BUFFER_APPENDED track TimeRanges, with the playhead from that observation. No event before an observed callback means unobserved, not an empty track. Copy finite numeric ranges only; never retain SourceBuffer/media payload objects.

hls_fragment uses actual fragment/part identity and observed fragment interval, startPTS/endPTS, discontinuity counter and public elementaryStreams numeric PTS. Elementary stream tracks are unique and at most3; unknown fields are null, absent streams[]. Every finite start/end pair is ordered; a discontinuity may change intervals across events.

hls_config copies exactly the twelve numeric effective hls.config fields. Infinity, NaN and unavailable fields become null. It is emitted on attachment and observed value changes during the existing1Hz loop, not an additional poller.

All event/rate/ring/lifecycle/export bounds remain unchanged. New detail events require non-null lane and session-local source_id; never export URLs, codec strings, raw errors or arbitrary configuration.

hls_live is emitted at most once per existing1Hz tick per lane from actual public latestLevelDetails.targetduration/edge, liveSyncPosition and latency getters and observed media position. Null means unavailable. No additional timer, network request, catch-up command or guessed seek reason.
Observed live latency may be negative after an overshoot or stale playlist; preserve its finite signed value instead of clamping it.

hls_live target/max latency and effective buffer length use public targetLatency/maxLatency/maxBufferLength getters. Current/load levels copy exact public getter indices and hls.levels[index] bitrate/maxBitrate. Index-1 or unavailable index carries null bitrates. These are observed advertised metadata, not measured throughput or inferred bitrate.
Never read hls.nextLoadLevel for diagnostics: its getter can compute or mutate ABR state. No next-level projection is exported.

The v1 and v2 contracts remain byte-for-byte unchanged. perf_capture_hls_policy:{version:3} adds explicit version3 capture and readers; perf_capture v1 and perf_capture_hls v2 capabilities remain unchanged. Version3 marker requires the valid base perf_capture capability.

Only explicit start version3 enables HLS policy details. Version1 and version2 captures preserve their existing event shapes. Every response including errors echoes the requested wire version; a version3 start must return capture_version3.

Version3 session metadata has capture_version1|2|3. Version3 status/read/stop can address all three capture versions without filtering or rewriting events. Lower wire versions cannot access a newer retained capture and return unsupported before any mutation. Start never silently upgrades or downgrades, or renews a retained session with incompatible options.

The event union includes legacy hls and hls_fragment shapes solely for capture_version1/2 in a version3 envelope. The read-response JSON Schema conditional and semantic validators both select exact event shape by capture_version. V3-only kinds and fields are forbidden in earlier captures. All HLS detail events require non-null lane and session-local source_id.

In capture_version3 hls.stats_retry replaces the legacy hls.retries name. It copies the mutable LoadStats.retry field at that callback: HLS internal gap/recovery handling can alter it. It is not a count of actual network retries. No actual network retry count is inferred or exported.

In capture_version3 hls_fragment.fragment_gap, part_gap and part_independent are observed public Fragment/Part flags; absent or unsupported values are null. elementary_streams[].partial copies the public elementary stream partial flag. These flags are observations, not an inferred network retry or a guaranteed decoder result.

hls_buffer_policy initial contains only four allowlisted constructor-time merged configuration numbers; it never reads mutable userConfig as original policy. initial_source unavailable requires all initial values null. A constructor snapshot can also contain null unsupported/nonfinite fields. current copies those four actual hls.config values at observation time.

hls_buffer_policy snapshot has previous_max_max_buffer_length_seconds null. cap_observation_changed requires previous and current max_max_buffer_length_seconds differ, including null availability transitions. No claim that every internal transition was captured, and no numeric-cap-change claim for null transitions. observation identifies attachment, existing sample tick, or HLS callback; no extra poller.

hls_buffer_policy cause is always unknown: the public API supplies no trustworthy causal event. Pre-capture history, private controller state and guessed reasons are not exported. Initial policy is four fixed numeric values per engine, with no content, callbacks or event recording while capture is off.

hls_error_action is a bounded projection of public ErrorData.errorAction at the callback. Fixed action enum, flags0..31, retry_budget_count and resolved are observations of the error-handler decision/shared budget, not proof a request was sent or retried. Unknown members become null; category/detail use fixed public-event projection.

Version3 hls.detail and hls_error_action.detail additionally distinguish buffer_full_error, internal_exception, buffer_append_no_progress and buffer_add_codec_error. Earlier captures retain their original detail enums. Error context is not a proven cause of a buffer-cap observation change.

All duration/event/byte/rate/ring/export bounds and lifecycle cleanup remain unchanged. No URLs, manifest content, codecs, raw errors, arbitrary config or private identifiers. Deploy compatible controller before enabling version3 on player/CLI; never retry a rejected mutation at a lower version.
